def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # locate hollow rectangular outline of 5s
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==5]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    marks=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    # marker colors outside frame, left/right positions; fill inner halves, with colors swapped across vertical midpoint per horizontal band
    left=next(v for r,c,v in marks if c<c0)
    right=next(v for r,c,v in marks if c>c1)
    midr=(r0+r1)//2; midc=(c0+c1)//2
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
      for c in range(c0+1,c1):
        # Demo indicates quadrant checker/cross: top-left & bottom-right left color; other quadrants right.
        g[r][c]=left if ((r<=midr)==(c<=midc)) else right
    return g
PY

def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    mr=(r0+r1)//2; mc=(c0+c1)//2
    for r in range(len(g)):
      for c in range(len(g[0])):
        v=g[r][c]
        if v in (0,5): continue
        qr=0 if r<r0 else 1 if r>r1 else (0 if r<=mr else 1)
        qc=0 if c<c0 else 1 if c>c1 else (0 if c<=mc else 1)
        # Diagonal category determined by marker's quadrant: TL or BR -> TL/BR; TR or BL -> TR/BL.
        same=(qr==qc)
        for rr in range(r0+1,r1):
          for cc in range(c0+1,c1):
            ar=0 if rr<=mr else 1; ac=0 if cc<=mc else 1
            if (ar==ac)==same: g[rr][cc]=v
    return g
PY
